answer: Each agent must lock slashable collateral to earn one vote, and votes count by the square root of stake. Splitting a purse across a knoll of fake identities gains nothing: ten seats mean ten deposits, and the square-root rule punishes the split. An attacker seeding clones from a jetty pays full collateral per seat, and a caught Sybil is slashed, so growing a yarrow patch of souls costs more capital than honest participation can earn.
